[[Floater (Fallout 76)|Floaters]] |robots = |quests = |terminal = |cell name =LookoutTower02Ext |refid ={{ID|00263963}} }} The '''north Kanawha lookout''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in [[the Forest]] region of [[Appalachia]]. It is located just east of [[Vault 76]]. ==Background== The lookout tower was once used by the [[Responders]]. Its occupants were overrun by [[Super mutant (Fallout 76)|super mutants]], who began using the tower for their own purposes. Before their deaths, the Responders at the tower threw away the key to a safe to prevent the mutants from getting into it.[[Responder's note]]''[[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide]]'' p. 287: '''''"03. NORTH KANAWHA LOOKOUT'''''
''Beware of Sickleman! At least, that's what the graffiti in the crawl space of the cabin on the grounds of this lookout tower states. Crawl up through the hole here to explore the cabin interior. Then check the tower and nearby outhouse for a key (atop an outhouse roof) to the safe atop the tower."''
([[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia]]) ==Layout== A number of [[Super mutant (Fallout 76)|super mutants]] inhabit this fire watchtower. Directly below it is a [[Cooking station (Fallout 76)|cooking station]] and an [[explosives crate]] surrounded by [[Meat bag (Fallout 76)|meat bag]]s put together by the super mutants, a majority of which can be found at the top of the tower; the room at the top of the stairs is littered with them, with a [[Safe (Fallout 76)|safe]] requiring a key in the center of the mess. The [[Safe key (Fallout 76)|safe key]] can be found on top of a port-a-potty to the west. Nearby is a [[Weapons workbench (Fallout 76)|weapons workbench]] and a [[Water pump (Fallout 76)|water pump]]. [[Rhododendron flower]]s and [[soot flower]]s can be harvested in the area. There is a ruined cabin near the lookout with graffiti in its crawlspace that states "[[Sickleman]] is here." Prior to the ''[[Wastelanders]]'' [[Fallout 76 updates|update]], the graffiti read "Sickleman ''was'' here."[https://twitter.com/NPurkeypile/status/1251957432961638400 Nate Purkeypile on Twitter]: ''":)"'' There are also several beheaded [[Skeleton (Fallout 76)|skeleton]]s near the graffiti. A hole in the floor here provides access to the cabin interior. ==Notable loot== * [[Responder's note]] - Note, on top of the safe inside the tower. * [[Safe key (Fallout 76)|Safe key]] - Found on top of a port-a-potty to the west. Opens the safe inside the tower. * Two potential [[Fallout 76 recipes|recipes]]: ** South of the tower, in the cabin with a hot tub. ** South of the tower, in the shack. ==Notes== Climbing to the top of the lookout lets the player character survey the area, which can unlock the following locations: {{columns|2| * [[Twin Pine Cabins]] * [[Gorge Junkyard]] * [[Landview Lighthouse]] * [[Isolated cabin]] * [[Moonshiner's shack]] * [[Gilman lumber mill]] * [[Wilson Brother's Auto Repair]] }} ==Appearances== The north Kanawha lookout appears only in ''[[Fallout 76]]''. ==Behind the scenes== The Sickleman graffiti at the cabin was implemented by lead artist [[Nathan Purkeypile]]. In fifth grade, he wrote a series of scary stories in which Sickleman was featured as a character. His teacher was "not too keen" about the subject matter in these stories, and she made his parents come in to discuss what he was writing in school. However, in the end, Purkeypile decided to channel the appreciation for monsters and "other weird things" into his eventual career as a video game artist.[https://web.archive.org/web/20210518183725/https://twitter.com/NPurkeypile/status/1394711968011931649 Nathan Purkeypile on Twitter] ==Gallery== FO76 North Kanawha lookout (Raider note).jpg|[[Responder's note]] FO76 Butterchurn Sickleman's cabin.png|Inside the cabin Sickle cell anemia man.png|Pre-''[[Wastelanders]]'' ==References== {{References}} '''Non-game''' {{References|group="Non-game"}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 outdoors theme locations]] [[Category:The Forest locations]] [[Category:Fallout 76 survey towers]] [[fr:Poste d'observation de Kanawha-nord]] [[ru:Вышка в северной Канове]] [[zh:北卡諾瓦瞭望塔]]

Settler's Ridge.content:
{{Infobox location |games =FO76,FO76BP |type =settlement medium |image =FO76AC Settler's Ridge.jpg |map marker ='''Settler's Ridge''' |map marker image = |local map = |part of =[[The Forest]], [[Appalachia]] |sections = |buildings = |doctors = |leaders =[[Ashley Ortega]] |merchants = |owners = |factions =[[Settlers (Wastelanders)|Settlers]] |creatures =[[Marty (Settler's Ridge)|Marty]] ([[Cat (Fallout 76)|cat]]) |robots = |quests = |terminal = |cell name =FoundationForestOutpostExt |refid ={{ID|00263E17}} |crafting = |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} |edid = }} '''Settler's Ridge''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in [[the Forest]] region of [[Appalachia]] {{in|FO76BP}}. It is an outpost for the [[Settlers (Wastelanders)|Settlers]] of [[Foundation]], with this settlement being led by [[Ashley Ortega]]. It can be found halfway between the waypoints of [[Vault 76]] and [[Anchor Farm]] to the northwest. ==Background== Settler's Ridge is one of several homesteads and communities established by the Settlers of Foundation.A [[Vault Dweller (Fallout 76)|Vault Dweller]]: ''"Where are the Settlers based?"''
[[Ashley Ortega]]: ''"We have little homesteads here and there, but our biggest settlement is Foundation, southeast of here. That's where we set up shop when we first arrived in Appalachia. Stop by if you're in the neighborhood. It's a sight to behold -- a real town, like before the war."''
([[Ashley Ortega/Dialogue|Ashley Ortega's dialogue]]) It was built by the Settlers to serve as a "new home" and as a "place worth living in."A [[Vault Dweller (Fallout 76)|Vault Dweller]]: ''"What are you building out here?"''
[[Ashley Ortega]]: ''"A new home. Nothing's more satisfying than turning this hellish world of ours into a place worth living in."''
([[Ashley Ortega/Dialogue|Ashley Ortega's dialogue]]) Settler's Ridge is also where once-famous [[Boston]] baseball player [[Nathan Broadhurst]] retired to after failing to find his [[Janice (Boardwalk Paradise)|fiancée]] in [[Charleston]]. Broadhurst left behind his [[Baseball bat (Fallout 76)|baseball bat]] and autobiography in the homestead to inspire future generations.[[Nathan Broadhurst's autobiogrophy]] ==Layout== {{Section|FO76AC}} ==Inhabitants== * [[Ashley Ortega]] * [[Settlers (Wastelanders)|Outpost settlers]] * [[Marty (Settler's Ridge)|Marty]] ([[Cat (Fallout 76)|cat]]) ==Notable loot== * [[Comrades in arms]] - Note, on a crate in the same wooden niche as the crafting workbenches. * [[Nathan Broadhurst's autobiogrophy]] - Note, hanging in a frame on the wall of one of the buildings. ==Appearances== Settler's Ridge appears only {{In|FO76AC}}. ==Behind the scenes== Level designer [[Ryan Johnson]] worked on the geography, layout and art of this location, in addition to writing the notes found at Settler's Ridge. Johnson received layout design guidance from [[Craig Bernardo]], art approval from [[Andrew Collins]] (who also worked on the lighting), while [[Christopher Marshall]] wrote the character of [[Ashley Ortega]].[https://www.artstation.com/artwork/8bNZDm Ryan Johnson on ArtStation: "Fallout 76 - Settler's Ridge"] ==Gallery== FO76AC Settler's Ridge 02.jpg|From the nearby hills FO76AC Settler's Ridge 03.jpg|Stairs leading up to the settlement FO76AC Settler's Ridge 04.jpg|Along the way to the entrance FO76AC Settler's ridge (Comrades in arms).jpg|[[Comrades in arms]] FO76AC Nathan Broadhursts autobiogrophy location.jpg|[[Nathan Broadhurst's autobiogrophy]] FO76AC Settler's Ridge (Ashley Ortega).jpg|Ashley Ortega FO76AC Settler's Ridge (Marty).jpg|Marty ==References== {{References}} '''Non-game''' {{References|group=Non-game}} {{Stub|FO76AC}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 locations]] [[Category:The Forest locations]] [[Category:Boardwalk Paradise locations]] [[ru:Хребет поселенцев]] [[zh:移民嶺]]
